import sys, random, json, ipaddress
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')

    transactions.append(tx)

vs=build_versions(cases[0])

    s,h=compute_runs(v)
    tot+=len(s)
    print('runs',len(s))
print('total',tot)
